about: Cash buy-in limits and structuring detection (#105; scope-v1 module 12; decision 0234). A cash buy-in is refused when it would take the member's cash buy-ins past the visit's limit (checked first) or the club day's (06:00 to 06:00 IST); reaching a limit exactly is within it. A limit of nothing, or none set, is no limit. A total ended just under a limit when it is within the margin of it (1,000 basis points is 10%), the limit itself included; the margin is rounded down to the paisa, so a total must be at least the limit less that margin. Structuring is that several times in the window (3 in 7 days unless set).

cases.description: ₹10,000 in cash with ₹20,000 bought this visit, at ₹40,000 a visit and ₹1,00,000 a day: within both.
₹10,000 more with ₹30,000 bought this visit: exactly the visit's ₹40,000, which is within it.
One chip more, ₹10,050: ₹50 past the visit's limit.
A new visit the same night: ₹20,000 this visit, but ₹90,000 already today, past the day's ₹1,00,000.
Past both: the visit's is named first.
No visit limit set (nothing): only the day's counts.
₹36,000 at a ₹40,000 limit, 10%: exactly the limit less ₹4,000, so just under it.
₹35,950: ₹50 short of the margin, so not.
₹40,000: the limit itself is just under it.
A margin that is not whole paise is rounded down: 3.33% of ₹1,00,001 is ₹3,330.0333, taken as ₹3,330.03, so ₹96,670.97 is near.
The paisa below it is not.
No limit (nothing): nothing is near it.
Nothing bought is not near any limit.
